2607.24507.title: UNIFUSION: Adapting Autoregressive Language Models into Discrete Diffusion under a Unified Reverse-Rate Objective
2607.24507.paper_summary: Existing methods mainly adapt pretrained autoregressive (AR) language models to masked diffusion, whereas we directly adapt them to uniform-noise diffusion, where every token remains editable during sampling. However, adapting AR checkpoints across corruption kernels remains challenging because existing DLMs use different objectives and prediction parameterizations. We establish connections among SEDD, MDLM/GIDD, M2S, and Neural CTMC by expressing their conditional losses as a single generalized Kullback--Leibler objective over model reverse rates. We further derive conversions from clean-token predictions to concrete-score, posterior-mean, and exit-rate/jump parameterizations, yielding a shared \(x_0\) interface that supports switching between mask and uniform kernels. Building on these connections, we propose \ours{}, a simple continual pre-training approach for directly adapting pretrained GPT2 checkpoints to uniform-noise diffusion. Through systematic evaluation of 124M- and 355M-parameter models, we show that \ours{} steadily improves the trade-off between generative perplexity (GenPPL) and unigram entropy as the sampling budget increases from 16 to 256 steps. At 256 steps, \ours{}-S and \ours{}-M achieve GenPPL/entropy pairs of \(97.783/5.2626\) and \(71.516/5.6669\), respectively; no evaluated model at the same scale simultaneously outperforms \ours{} on both metrics. At both scales, \ours{} also achieves the highest WinoGrande, SIQA, and BBH accuracy among the compared diffusion models.
2607.24507.paper_summary_zh: 現有的方法主要將預訓練的自回歸 (AR) 語言模型適應於遮罩擴散，而我們則直接將其適應於均勻噪聲擴散，在此過程中，每個標記在取樣期間都保持可編輯。然而，跨腐蝕內核適應 AR 檢查點仍然具有挑戰性，因為現有的 DLM 使用不同的目標和預測參數化。我們通過將它們的條件損失表達為模型反向速率上的單一廣義 Kullback--Leibler 目標，建立了 SEDD、MDLM/GIDD、M2S 和 Neural CTMC 之間的聯繫。我們進一步推導出從乾淨標記預測到具體分數、後驗均值和退出率/跳躍參數化的轉換，產生一個共享的 \(x_0\) 接口，支持在遮罩和均勻內核之間切換。在這些聯繫的基礎上，我們提出了 \ours{}，這是一種簡單的持續預訓練方法，旨在直接將預訓練的 GPT2 檢查點適應於均勻噪聲擴散。通過對 124M 和 355M 參數模型的系統評估，我們顯示 \ours{} 隨著取樣預算從 16 增加到 256 步驟，穩步改善生成困惑度 (GenPPL) 和 unigram 熵之間的權衡。在 256 步驟時，\ours{}-S 和 \ours{}-M 分別達到 GenPPL/熵對 \(97.783/5.2626\) 和 \(71.516/5.6669\)；在相同規模下，沒有評估的模型在這兩個指標上同時超越 \ours{}。在這兩個規模下，\ours{} 也在比較的擴散模型中達到了最高的 WinoGrande、SIQA 和 BBH 準確率。
